reporting.store_pipeline_note: STORE: Material Pipeline (open=49, won=6, lost=7, abandoned=2, total=64) is retail material sales, kept separate from project work. Open breakdown: 3 in 'Quote Provided', 3 'Engaged (Manual)', 26 in the '+8d Final Follow-up (Auto)' stage, plus 13 sitting in '6a. Closed - Won' and 4 in '6b. Closed - Lost' while opportunity status still reads 'open' -- a stage/status data-hygiene mismatch worth a look. stale_thresholds_used._comment: Echoed from platform-settings/ghl-workflow.json so a threshold change is visible in the diff.

meeting_window_summary._comment: Threshold counts from stage entry, not the appointment. Exact appointment dates are only retrievable via the API for records with an upcoming/recent calendar event still linked (2 of 35 today); for the other 33, days_in_stage is used as the best-available proxy for days_since_appointment in workflow_drift, since the 2 confirmed samples show the visit happens only 2-8 days after stage entry.

reporting.undocumented_tag_observed: 'abandoned-stale' appeared on 3 open opportunities (e.g. *Bash | Mississauga, *Tina | Mississauga) -- not in the documented tag vocabulary. Treated as distinct from 'stale_lead' in this run's counts; worth confirming with Albert whether it's a synonym or a separate status.
